subject: reasoning
question:
A # B means 'A is the brother of B'

A @ B means 'A is the daughter of B'

A & B means 'A is the husband of B'

A % B means 'A is the wife of B'

If C@N&K@H%P#M@J&F, then how is K related to J?
solution:
Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree.

 
 

 
 
A is

Now draw a family tree using the following notations:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

 

From the given information we substitute the values in the given equation:

C@N&K@H%P#M@J&F means,

C is the daughter of N, N is the husband of K, K is the daughter of H, H is the wife of P, P is the brother of M, M is the daughter of J, and J is the husband of F. 

Family Tree: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa1a75d673fb783d23afda855217c0f56c069f0b60a0e282b756283dafdfe687.png] 

From the chart, we can see that **K is son's daughter of J.**

Hence the correct answer is **option 1)**
